strings.options.weapon_hud.label: Weapon HUD
strings.options.weapon_hud.description: Ammo, heat and a separate charge arc. After toggling in a mission, firing may be needed to refresh the state.
strings.options.frv_hud.label: FRV HUD
strings.options.frv_hud.description: After toggling in a mission, entering or exiting a vehicle may be needed to refresh the state.
strings.options.tank_hud.label: Tank HUD
strings.options.tank_hud.description: After toggling in a mission, entering or exiting a vehicle may be needed to refresh the state.
strings.options.mech_hud.label: Mech HUD
strings.options.mech_hud.description: After toggling in a mission, entering or exiting a mech may be needed to refresh the state.
strings.options.booster_hud.label: Squad booster icons
strings.options.booster_hud.description: Master switch for booster icons. Icons beside health bars may be misassigned; the player list uses player identity.
strings.options.booster_display.label: Booster display
strings.options.booster_display.description: Health-bar icons may be inaccurate. The player list is recommended for accurate matching. The list shows teammates only.
strings.options.network_hud.label: Latency numbers
strings.options.network_hud.description: Controls latency numbers only. The panel is hidden when both latency numbers and list boosters are disabled.
strings.options.weapon_scale.label: Weapon HUD size
strings.options.weapon_scale.description: Percent. Scales the weapon HUD proportionally around the fixed crosshair-center anchor.
strings.options.ammo_number_scale.label: Ammo number size
strings.options.ammo_number_scale.description: Percent. Scales magazine and reserve numbers around their center, in addition to the overall weapon HUD scale.
strings.options.network_scale.label: Player panel size
strings.options.network_scale.description: Percent. Scales the player panel proportionally. The default position is the center of the left screen edge.
strings.options.network_x.label: Player panel horizontal position
strings.options.network_y.label: Player panel vertical position
strings.options.language.label: Language
strings.options.language.description: Follow the MDL interface language, or select Simplified Chinese, English, or Russian. In Auto mode, unreadable or unsupported MDL languages fall back to English.
strings.mod.title: Integrated HUD
